about.title: Serving Pilgrims Since 2011
about.subtitle: Founded on the core belief that pilgrimage should be an elevating sacred experience, free from logistical anxiety.
about.storyP1: OmraPlan was established with a singular vision: to grant pilgrims a journey worthy of the sanctity of the Two Holy Mosques. For more than 14 years, we have personally inspected every hotel, curated premium transport, and trained our guides to serve with absolute care.
about.storyP2: We do not regard the pilgrimage as mere tourism, but as the journey of a lifetime. From theological workshops prior to departure until your safe return home, we stand beside you every step of the way.
about.val1Desc: Official licensing, direct scheduled flights, Haramain high-speed rail, and flawless round-the-clock coordination.
about.val2Desc: Bilingual, credentialed scholars explaining sacred rituals according to the authentic prophetic tradition with gentle warmth.
about.val3Desc: Selected 5-star hotels located within 250 meters of the holy plazas, providing ease for elders and young families.
about.commit1: Complete price transparency with zero hidden fees.
about.commit2: 24/7 bilingual on-site medical and logistical assistance.
about.commit3: Human-scale travel groups for personal attention.
about.commit4: Comprehensive preparatory seminars prior to departure.
